description:
Tighnari is a playable Dendro character in Genshin Impact .

Tighnari is the stern Chief Officer of the Forest Rangers and Collei 's mentor. Despite his intelligence, he prefers to live a solitary life in the depths of Avidya Forest rather than in the ivory tower of Sumeru Akademiya .
role_summary: Tighnari is a playable Dendro character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Khanda Barrier-Buster
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow. Charged Attack Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG. While aiming, the power of Dendro will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged: Charge

talents.name: Vijnana-Phala Mine
talents.description: Tighnari throws a Vijnana Stormheart ahead that deals AoE Dendro DMG , creating a Vijnana-Khanda Field that creates mysterious illusions that taunt opponents and draw their fire. Additionally, Tighnari gains the Vijnana Suffusion effect, which will decrease the Wreath Arrow's charging time by 2.4s. This effect will dissipate once the skill duration ends or after Tighnari has fired 3 Wreath Arrows.

talents.name: Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft
talents.description: Combines the power of all seeds to fire 6 Tanglevine Shafts that can track opponents and deal Dendro DMG . After they hit, the Tanglevine Shafts will create a secondary wave of Tanglevine Shafts that can also track nearby opponents and deal Dendro DMG on hit.

talents.name: Keen Sight
talents.description: After Tighnari fires a Wreath Arrow, his Elemental Mastery is increased by 50 for 4s.

talents.name: Scholarly Blade
talents.description: For every point of Elemental Mastery Tighnari possesses, his Charged Attack and Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft DMG are increased by 0.06%. The maximum DMG Bonus obtainable this way is 60%.

talents.name: Encyclopedic Knowledge
talents.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Sumeru on the mini-map .

c1.name: Beginnings Determined at the Roots
c1.effect: Tighnari's Charged Attack CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

c2.name: Origins Known From the Stem
c2.effect: When there are opponents within the Vijnana-Khanda Field created by Vijnana-Phala Mine , Tighnari gains 20% Dendro DMG Bonus . The effect will last up to 6s if the field's duration ends or if it no longer has opponents within it.

c3.name: Fortunes Read Amongst the Branches
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Withering Glimpsed in the Leaves
c4.effect: When Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft is unleashed, all nearby party members gain 60 Elemental Mastery for 8s. If the Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft triggers a Burning , Bloom , Lunar-Bloom , Quicken , or Spread reaction, their Elemental Mastery will be further increased by 60. This latter case will also refresh the buff state's duration.

c5.name: Comprehension Amidst the Flowers
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Vijnana-Phala Mine by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Karma Adjudged From the Leaden Fruit
c6.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Advanced Properties Preview Wreath Arrow 's charging time is decreased by 0.9s, and will produce 1 additional Clusterbloom Arrow upon hit. This arrow deals 150% of Tighnari's ATK as DMG. When this Constellation is combined with Tighnari's Elemental Skill , Wreath Arrows will not require charging at all.
